messages.subject: Problems w download graphic button
parts:
Hi everyone, 

I created a shiny app (found here: http://spark.rstudio.com/veromora/BiocharEng/) which generates graphical output of a model, which is displayed in the "Graphic" tab, and (the exact same graphical output) can also be downloaded as a pdf from the side bar button called "Download Graphic". Recently, however, a peculiar problem has come up with shiny being unable to create the pdf (an empty pdf is generated) if the real time "Graphic" tab is viewed first. The download button works perfectly fine if the site is refreshed and any of the tabs that are NOT the "Graphic" tab have been viewed prior to attempting to download the graphic. This was not a problem when I created the site last year, so I am at a loss as to what is happening now. Can anyone provide some advise or the shiny app technical support check if this is an issue with the shiny server itself? It is strange that the download works conditional to what reactive output has been viewed first. 

Many thanks, 

Veronica
